## Personality

Jane is a steady, sensible, and lady-like individual who possesses a deep fondness for the woods. Although she finds the work monotonous, she is motivated to devote her entire life to teaching and intends to never marry.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021), [v1 CHAPTER XXXII. ## History

[Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md) joined a story club alongside her friends and excelled in her education, passing the [Entrance](../codex/places.md#entrance) examinations and eventually taking home economics honors at Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#academy) before teaching school at [Newbridge](../codex/places.md#newbridge). During her time in school, she visited [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) at her boarding house and shared the news about the Avery scholarship. She later joined [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), and [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) on a memorable spring walk through the woods to discover Hester Gray's old garden. As an active member of the local [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers), Jane also joined [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) in an unsuccessful attempt to persuade [Judson Parker](../character/judson-parker.md) not to rent his fence to a patent medicine company for advertising.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER II. Matthew Cuthbert Is Surprised P40](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0040), [v1 CHAPTER II. Matthew Cuthbert Is Surprised P42](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0042), [v1 CHAPTER II. Matthew Cuthbert Is Surprised P47](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0047), [v1 CHAPTER II. ## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--jane.md)

Jane and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) are longtime friends and fellow students who studied together in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) and at Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#academy). Along with other classmates, Jane visited [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) while boarding in town and informed her about the Avery scholarship opportunity. Their friendship continues beyond their school days, with Jane joining [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) on social outings such as a spring walk to celebrate Anne's adopted birthday.

- Friend of — longtime friends and fellow students  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXXVI. The Glory and the Dream P2](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0002), [v2 IV Different Opinions P0](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0000), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P0](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0000), +1 more</sub>

### [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/diana-barry--jane.md)

Jane and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) share a mutual friendship within their close-knit circle of peers in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea). They enjoy social gatherings and leisure activities together, including a spring picnic walk to Hester Gray's hidden garden. They also collaborate on community matters, such as joining forces in an attempt to persuade [Judson Parker](../character/judson-parker.md) not to rent his fence for patent medicine advertisements.

- Friend of — friends who attend concerts and share sympathy together  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P32](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0032)</sub>

### [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/jane--priscilla-grant.md)

Jane and [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) are friendly companions who socialize within the same group of friends. They shared a memorable day together on a spring walk across the woods and fields to celebrate Anne's adopted birthday. During the excursion, they explored nature, shared lunch by a brook, and listened to local stories.

- Comrade of — friends attending a spring picnic day together (since v2)  <sub>[v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P3](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0003)</sub>
